scopeNote: For eligible applicants who already submitted a PR application. BOWP approval allows temporary work under its conditions; it is not PR approval. Keep PR milestones in the separate PR roadmap. Community averages combine applications within this guide and are not IRCC processing estimates.

relatedPathways.label: Canadian Experience Class
relatedPathways.description: Qualifying Canadian work may support CEC eligibility. Work gained while studying full-time does not count toward the CEC minimum. Meeting eligibility does not guarantee an invitation.

relatedPathways.label: Provincial nominee programs
relatedPathways.description: Check the province’s current stream rules, selection process and settlement-intent requirements. A permit alone does not qualify you for nomination or guarantee PR.

steps.title: Check your PR application and status
steps.description: Check BOWP eligibility for the PR program you applied under and your current status in Canada. An Express Entry profile or invitation alone is insufficient.

preparationChecklist.text: Confirm you are the principal applicant.

steps.title: Prepare the required PR evidence
steps.description: Provide the acknowledgement of receipt and relevant nomination evidence. PNP applicants must have no employment restrictions in their nomination. Express Entry applicants must pass the completeness check; non-Express Entry PNP applicants must pass the eligibility assessment. Follow the rules for your PR program.

requiredDocuments.title: Acknowledgement of receipt
requiredDocuments.condition: Include when required by your IRCC checklist or the linked instructions.

requiredDocuments.title: Nomination evidence where applicable
requiredDocuments.condition: Include when required by your IRCC checklist or the linked instructions.

preparationChecklist.text: Confirm the requirements for Express Entry PNP versus non-Express Entry PNP.

steps.title: Submit the bridging application
steps.description: Follow the work-permit extension instructions and pay applicable fees. Apply before expiry where eligible, or check restoration requirements.

requiredDocuments.title: Work permit application and status evidence
requiredDocuments.condition: Include when required by your IRCC checklist or the linked instructions.

preparationChecklist.text: Keep the confirmation and existing work permit.

steps.title: Confirm permission to work while waiting
steps.description: Work authorization while waiting depends on your status and compliance with maintained-status rules. Restoration applicants cannot assume permission to work.

preparationChecklist.text: Check travel implications and existing permit conditions.

steps.title: Respond to IRCC and review the decision
steps.description: Provide requested evidence and, if approved, check the permit’s conditions and expiry. Continue tracking the PR decision separately.

requiredDocuments.title: Issued work permit
requiredDocuments.condition: Include when required by your IRCC checklist or the linked instructions.

preparationChecklist.text: Check any provincial or occupational restrictions.
